result.topic_en: Draft notes, written over a printed postal ledger form, on counting the number of coincident values (cases where two roots coincide) of the equation $G(\sigma,\sigma')=0$ between two rational functions $\sigma,\sigma'$ on an algebraic curve $F(s,z)=0$ of genus $p$, with formulas such as $r=(\mu-1)(\mu'-1)-p$ and special cases for $p=1,2$, $2\mu-3$, $2\mu-2$.
